name: code-workflow
description: Safe, test-driven workflows for planning, implementation, review, refactoring, source analysis, and GitHub Flow. Includes product discovery, MVP scoping, and development plans with app-service-planning.

interface.longDescription: Plan bounded work, implement with verification, review changes, refactor safely, analyze source code, and run explicitly authorized GitHub Flow phases. Clarify product ideas and define MVPs before implementation.
defaultPrompt: Plan this change as small, verifiable work orders.
Review the current diff for regressions and missing tests.
Analyze this codebase and produce resumable architecture docs.
Clarify this app idea, define its MVP, and write a development plan.
